name: 3.4GHz-3.6GHz 50W RF High Power VCO WIFI Jammer Module

The compact, modular form factor and standard RF connectors ensure seamless integration into existing electronic warfare suites. Leveraging ACASOM’s extensive RF and microwave engineering expertise, this module offers precise frequency control and spectral purity, minimizing unintended interference while maximizing target suppression. Whether securing high-value locations or establishing controlled airspace, the ACASOM 830MHz–960MHz 100W GaN Jammer Module offers a robust and scalable countermeasure against illicit drone incursions. Combining flexibility with rugged performance, it sets a new standard for UAV denial systems.
